answer.reason: The verses tell two deeds of Hanun beyond the summary: his humiliation of David's servants and his hiring of foreign forces against David.

clauses.english: shamed David's messengers by shaving them and cutting off their garments
clauses.quote: Hanun took David's servants, and shaved off the one half of their beards

clauses.english: hired Syrian forces to fight David after the insult
clauses.quote: Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen

doubts: 2SA 10:1 and 10:2 only repeat the summary (king, son of Nahash), so they are not cited.
